strings.name: Marc Benioff
strings.summary: Benioff entered technology through programming and sales and marketing at Oracle. In 1999 he co-founded Salesforce, promoting internet-delivered enterprise software. The company expanded from customer management into cloud platforms and acquired Slack. He also promoted corporate philanthropy, bought TIME with his wife and supported healthcare and environmental projects.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founding Salesforce and promoting software as a service helped spread enterprise customer management and cloud applications.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: B.S. in business administration, University of Southern California (1986).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Enterprise software moves to the cloud
strings.highlights.h1.text: Promoted subscription-based customer relationship management through Salesforce.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Embedding corporate philanthropy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Advocated donating 1% of equity, products and employee time to communities.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Setting out an AI strategy
strings.timeline.t1.text: His 2026 shareholder letter prioritized Agentforce and enterprise AI applications.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Announcing Hawaiian healthcare gifts
strings.timeline.t2.text: With his wife Lynne, announced $150 million in gifts to Hawaiian medical centers.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Salesforce completes Slack acquisition
strings.timeline.t3.text: The company added collaboration software to its enterprise cloud portfolio.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Acquiring TIME
strings.timeline.t4.text: He and his wife acquired TIME personally, independently of Salesforce.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Salesforce flotation
strings.timeline.t5.text: The company completed its initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Becoming chief executive
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became Salesforce CEO, alongside the chairmanship held since its founding.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Co-founding Salesforce
strings.timeline.t7.text: Established the company with a team to develop internet-delivered enterprise applications.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Graduating and joining Oracle
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed his USC degree and developed sales, marketing and product experience at Oracle.
